caption: Lion Gate, Mycenae
composition: Headless lion relief above the citadel gate · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the approach outside the citadel, the Lion Gate fills the frame: conglomerate walls, a heavy lintel, and the triangular relief of two headless lions flanking a column. Cloud cover is about 57%, about 15.2°C, and the site is unlit, so the relief is in moonlight. The portrait master is a tighter crop of this same frame.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Lion Gate at Mycenae in moonlight, lions without heads
